Ever make sense to reuse? ZSTD_CCtx_reset... ?
The way bmwceb operates, we free all the memory when we're done.  Maybe in other cases it might make sense to make a reusable object, but I don't think that makes sense here.
Talked with Gunnar offline;  Pretty sure this can be closed.

Seems like a reasonable choice.. 
"Default (Level 3): Excellent balance, faster than gzip, often used for web content/data transfer."

Since bmcweb is targeted for an AST2500/AST2600 or similar.. 1, least amount of CPU usage, could also be a consideration.

👍

If we find this value sucks, we can always mess with it.

Their example here 
https://github.com/facebook/zstd/blob/1168da0e567960d50cba1b58c9b0ba047ece4733/examples/streaming_compression.c#L78
also includes a check for input.. Do you need more in this while loop ?

I've added that behavior.  In the docs it only seems to matter if you call flush, but it's good to have the same behavior as the reference in case they change.
